name: Modules.CoreMotion
summary: Allows Titanium client applications to access Apple's CoreMotion APIs.

properties.name: ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_CORRECTED_Z_VERTICAL
properties.summary:
Describes the same reference frame as
[Modules.CoreMotion.ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_Z_VERTICAL](api:Modules.CoreMotion#ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_Z_VERTICAL)
except that the magnetometer, when available and calibrated, is used to
improve long-term yaw accuracy. Using this constant instead of
[Modules.CoreMotion.ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_Z_VERTICAL](api:Modules.CoreMotion#ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_Z_VERTICAL)
results in increased CPU usage.

properties.name: ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_ARBITRARY_Z_VERTICAL
properties.summary:
Describes a reference frame in which the Z axis is vertical and the X axis points
in an arbitrary direction in the horizontal plane.

properties.name: ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_MAGNETIC_NORTH_Z_VERTICAL
properties.summary:
Describes a reference frame in which the Z axis is vertical and the X axis points
toward magnetic north. Note that using this reference frame may require device
movement to calibrate the magnetometer.

properties.name: ATTITUDE_REFERENCE_FRAME_X_TRUE_NORTH_Z_VERTICAL
properties.summary:
Describes a reference frame in which the Z axis is vertical and the X axis points
toward true north. Note that using this reference frame may require device movement
to calibrate the magnetometer. It also requires the location to be available in order
to calculate the difference between magnetic and true north.

properties.name: AUTHORIZATION_STATUS_AUTHORIZED
properties.summary: Access is authorized by the user.

properties.name: AUTHORIZATION_STATUS_DENIED
properties.summary: Access is denied by the user.

properties.name: AUTHORIZATION_STATUS_NOT_DETERMINED
properties.summary: The user has not been prompted yet.

properties.name: AUTHORIZATION_STATUS_RESTRICTED
properties.summary: Access is denied due to system-wide restrictions.

properties.name: ERROR_DEVICE_REQUIRES_MOVEMENT
properties.summary: The device must move for a sampling of motion data to occur.

properties.name: ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER
properties.summary: An invalid parameter was specified.

properties.name: ERROR_MOTION_ACTIVITY_NOT_AUTHORIZED
properties.summary: The app is not currently authorized to use motion activity support.

properties.name: ERROR_MOTION_ACTIVITY_NOT_AVAILABLE
properties.summary: Motion activity support is not available on the current device.

properties.name: ERROR_MOTION_ACTIVITY_NOT_ENTITLED
properties.summary: The app is missing a required entitlement.

properties.name: ERROR_NULL
properties.summary: No error.

properties.name: ERROR_TRUE_NORTH_NOT_AVAILABLE
properties.summary: True north is not available on this device. This usually indicates that the device's location is not yet available.

properties.name: ERROR_UNKNOWN
properties.summary: An unknown error occurred.

properties.name: MAGNETIC_FIELD_CALIBRATION_ACCURACY_HIGH
properties.summary: The accuracy of the magnetic field calibration is high.

properties.name: MAGNETIC_FIELD_CALIBRATION_ACCURACY_LOW
properties.summary: The accuracy of the magnetic field calibration is low.

properties.name: MAGNETIC_FIELD_CALIBRATION_ACCURACY_MEDIUM
properties.summary: The accuracy of the magnetic field calibration is medium.

properties.name: MAGNETIC_FIELD_CALIBRATION_ACCURACY_UNCALIBRATED
properties.summary: The magnetic field estimate is not calibrated.

properties.name: MOTION_ACTIVITY_CONFIDENCE_HIGH
properties.summary: Confidence is high.

properties.name: MOTION_ACTIVITY_CONFIDENCE_LOW
properties.summary: Confidence is low.

properties.name: MOTION_ACTIVITY_CONFIDENCE_MEDIUM
properties.summary: Confidence is good.

deprecated.notes:
This API was deprecated by Apple in iOS 7 and is only available for backward compatibility 
with older versions of this module. It will be removed in the next release. Please use
[Modules.CoreMotion.Pedometer](Modules.CoreMotion.Pedometer) API instead, which provides the same functionality including
new properties like `floorCount` and `distance`.
